panel.autoWootHint: Woot each new track automatically (30s delay)
panel.autoGrabHint: After a woot: grab now on enable, then 5s delay on later tracks
panel.randomPlaylistHint: Activate a random selected playlist when you are next / DJ

playlists.grabReady: Tracks are saved into the selected playlist. Auto Grab runs after a woot.
playlists.signIn: Sign in and create a playlist, then reopen RoboWoot to refresh.

playlists.randomNeed: Check at least one playlist that has tracks, then enable Random Playlist.
playlists.chooseBeforeGrab: Choose a playlist before enabling Auto Grab.
